BOOK3_LESSON_THIRTEEN_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–3 · Cloud Technology Is Really Convenient

text.traditional: 明哲，你不要一直看手機啦。
text.simplified: 明哲，你不要一直看手机啦。
text.pinyin: Míngzhé, nǐ búyào yìzhí kàn shǒujī la.
text.english: Mingzhe, don't keep staring at your phone all the time.

text.traditional: 我在查借書記錄，看看雲端圖書館的電子書還能借多久。
text.simplified: 我在查借书记录，看看云端图书馆的电子书还能借多久。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài chá jiè shū jìlù, kànkan yúnduān túshūguǎn de diànzǐshū hái néng jiè duōjiǔ.
text.english: I'm checking my borrowing record to see how much longer I can keep the cloud library e-book.

text.traditional: 我從來沒用過雲端圖書館系統，你可以教我嗎？
text.simplified: 我从来没用过云端图书馆系统，你可以教我吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi yòng guò yúnduān túshūguǎn xìtǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
text.english: I have never used the cloud library system before. Could you teach me?

text.traditional: 妳只要上雲端圖書館的網站填資料，建立帳號、密碼，就能用了。
text.simplified: 你只要上云端图书馆的网站填资料，建立帐号、密码，就能用了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐyào shàng yúnduān túshūguǎn de wǎngzhàn tián zīliào, jiànlì zhànghào, mìmǎ, jiù néng yòng le.
text.english: You just need to fill in information on the cloud library website and create an account and password, then you can use it.

text.traditional: 聽起來不難嘛！什麼時候借都可以嗎？
text.simplified: 听起来不难嘛！什么时候借都可以吗？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái bù nán ma! Shénme shíhòu jiè dōu kěyǐ ma?
text.english: Sounds easy! Can you borrow anytime?

text.traditional: 是啊，而且還書時間一到，系統就會自動還書。不像以前，想借書只能親自跑一趟圖書館，要是多借了幾本，還得抱著一堆書回家。
text.simplified: 是啊，而且还书时间一到，系统就会自动还书。不像以前，想借书只能亲自跑一趟图书馆，要是多借了几本，还得抱着一堆书回家。
text.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě huán shū shíjiān yí dào, xìtǒng jiù huì zìdòng huán shū. Bú xiàng yǐqián, xiǎng jiè shū zhǐ néng qīnzì pǎo yí tàng túshūguǎn, yàoshì duō jiè le jǐ běn, hái děi bào zhe yì duī shū huí jiā.
text.english: Yes, and as soon as the due date arrives, the system returns it automatically. It's not like before, when you had to go to the library in person to borrow books, and if you borrowed a few extra, you had to carry a pile of books home.

text.traditional: 現在的讀者實在太幸福了。
text.simplified: 现在的读者实在太幸福了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de dúzhě shízài tài xìngfú le.
text.english: Modern readers are truly fortunate.

text.traditional: 就是啊，只要帶著手機或平板，就能隨時隨地閱讀了。
text.simplified: 就是啊，只要带着手机或平板，就能随时随地阅读了。
text.pinyin: Jiùshì a, zhǐyào dài zhe shǒujī huò píngbǎn, jiù néng suíshí suídì yuèdú le.
text.english: Exactly; as long as you carry a phone or tablet, you can read anytime, anywhere.

text.traditional: 這樣我的書包就能變得很空，放得下外套、雨傘什麼的。
text.simplified: 这样我的书包就能变得很空，放得下外套、雨伞什么的。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng wǒ de shūbāo jiù néng biàn de hěn kòng, fàng de xià wàitào, yǔsǎn shénme de.
text.english: That way my schoolbag can become very spacious, leaving room for a coat, umbrella, and so on.

text.traditional: 是啊。現在我什麼文件都存在雲端，要是忘了帶隨身碟也不必擔心。
text.simplified: 是啊。现在我什么文件都存在云端，要是忘了带随身碟也不必担心。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ shénme wénjiàn dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàoshì wàngle dài suíshēndié yě búbì dānxīn.
text.english: Indeed. Now I store all documents in the cloud; even if I forget my flash drive, there is no need to worry.

text.traditional: 有一次小組發表報告前五分鐘，我發現忘了帶隨身碟，也沒把預備好的資料寄到同學的電子信箱。我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份，問題就馬上解決了。
text.simplified: 有一次小组发表报告前五分钟，我发现忘了带随身碟，也没把预备好的资料寄到同学的电子信箱。我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份，问题就马上解决了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì xiǎozǔ fābiǎo bàogào qián wǔ fēnzhōng, wǒ fāxiàn wàngle dài suíshēndié, yě méi bǎ yùbèi hǎo de zīliào jì dào tóngxué de diànzǐ xìnxiāng. Wǒ nà shíhòu xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méibànfǎ bàogào le, háihǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn, wèntí jiù mǎshàng jiějué le.
text.english: Once, five minutes before our group presentation, I found I had forgotten my flash drive and hadn't emailed the prepared files to classmates. I thought, 'Now we can't present!' Luckily a classmate said there was a copy on the cloud, and the problem was resolved immediately.

text.traditional: 現在的網路科技水平提高了不少，企業能透過高速網路把資料上傳到雲端處理，不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
text.simplified: 现在的网路科技水平提高了不少，企业能透过高速网路把资料上传到云端处理，不同地区的人也能在网路上一起开会，既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de wǎnglù kējì shuǐpíng tígāo le bùshǎo, qìyè néng tòuguò gāosù wǎnglù bǎ zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān chǔlǐ, bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng bié shuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxī děng jīběn fúwù le.
text.english: Internet technology has improved a lot these days. Businesses can upload data to the cloud over high-speed internet for processing, and people in different places can also hold meetings together online, which both saves time and is convenient, not to mention basic services like downloading personal data and sending messages.

text.traditional: 除了這些優點，雲端還能把會議資料自動存起來，也能把變更的時間和內容記錄下來，讓不能參加會議的人隨時掌握最新情況。
text.simplified: 除了这些优点，云端还能把会议资料自动存起来，也能把变更的时间和内容记录下来，让不能参加会议的人随时掌握最新情况。
text.pinyin: Chúle zhèxiē yōudiǎn, yúnduān hái néng bǎ huìyì zīliào zìdòng cún qǐlái, yě néng bǎ biàngēng de shíjiān hé nèiróng jìlù xiàlái, ràng bùnéng cānjiā huìyì de rén suíshí zhǎngwò zuìxīn qíngkuàng.
text.english: Besides these advantages, the cloud can also save meeting files automatically and record when and what was changed, so people who can't attend the meeting can keep up with the latest situation at any time.

text.traditional: 其實也有不少老師利用這樣的科技，把教材放上雲端，讓學生預習、複習，提高學習的效果。
text.simplified: 其实也有不少老师利用这样的科技，把教材放上云端，让学生预习、复习，提高学习的效果。
text.pinyin: Qíshí yě yǒu bùshǎo lǎoshī lìyòng zhèyàng de kējì, bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí, fùxí, tígāo xuéxí de xiàoguǒ.
text.english: Actually, quite a few teachers use this technology, putting course materials on the cloud for students to preview and review, making their learning more effective.

text.traditional: 不過，我覺得要利用雲端科技來改變傳統的教學方式，恐怕說起來容易，做起來不簡單吧。
text.simplified: 不过，我觉得要利用云端科技来改变传统的教学方式，恐怕说起来容易，做起来不简单吧。
text.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ juéde yào lìyòng yúnduān kējì lái gǎibiàn chuántǒng de jiàoxué fāngshì, kǒngpà shuōqǐlái róngyì, zuò qǐlái bù jiǎndān ba.
text.english: However, I think using cloud technology to transform conventional teaching methods is probably easier said than done.

text.traditional: （明哲的手機忽然響了，他看了看雲端日曆。）
text.simplified: （明哲的手机忽然响了，他看了看云端日历。）
text.pinyin: (Míngzhé de shǒujī hūrán xiǎng le, tā kàn le kàn yúnduān rìlì.)
text.english: (Mingzhe's phone suddenly rings; he checks his cloud calendar.)

text.traditional: 明天系主任邀請馬博士來演講，題目跟雲端科技有關，妳要一起去嗎？
text.simplified: 明天系主任邀请马博士来演讲，题目跟云端科技有关，你要一起去吗？
text.pinyin: Míngtiān xì zhǔrèn yāoqǐng Mǎ bóshì lái yǎnjiǎng, tímù gēn yúnduān kējì yǒuguān, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
text.english: The department chair has invited Dr. Ma to give a talk tomorrow on a topic related to cloud technology. Do you want to go together?

text.traditional: 說實話，我本來對雲端科技沒什麼興趣，今天聽你說了這麼多，似乎該研究一下了。
text.simplified: 说实话，我本来对云端科技没什么兴趣，今天听你说了这么多，似乎该研究一下了。
text.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wǒ běnlái duì yúnduān kējì méishénme xìngqù, jīntiān tīng nǐ shuō le zhème duō, sìhū gāi yánjiù yíxià le.
text.english: Honestly, I initially had little interest in cloud tech, but hearing you share so much today, it seems I should look into it.

text.traditional: 那我明天騎摩托車去接妳。
text.simplified: 那我明天骑摩托车去接你。
text.pinyin: Nà wǒ míngtiān qí mótuōchē qù jiē nǐ.
text.english: Then I'll pick you up on my scooter tomorrow.

text.traditional: 太好了！麻煩你了！
text.simplified: 太好了！麻烦你了！
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Máfán nǐ le!
text.english: Wonderful! Thanks so much!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an immediate realization, reaction, or consequence of a sudden situation using 這下子 ('now / as a result').
grammarPages.explanation: 在對話中說到某件事情或情況，說話的人表達自己的看法，也可以是自己面對突然發生的情況，當下做出的反應。

text.traditional: 我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份……
text.simplified: 我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份……
text.pinyin: Wǒ nà shíhòu xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méibànfǎ bàogào le, háihǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn…
text.english: At that moment I thought, now I won't be able to give the presentation, but luckily a classmate said there was also a copy in the cloud…

text.traditional:
A：唉，我們工廠早上突然停電了，到現在還沒恢復，什麼都做不了。
B：真的？這下子你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
text.simplified:
A：唉，我们工厂早上突然停电了，到现在还没恢复，什么都做不了。
B：真的？这下子你们的货赶得出来吗？
text.pinyin:
A: Āi, wǒmen gōngchǎng zǎoshàng túrán tíngdiàn le, dào xiànzài háiméi huīfù, shénme dōu zuò bùliǎo.
B: Zhēnde? Zhèxiàzi nǐmen de huò gǎn de chūlái ma?
text.english:
A: Ugh, our factory suddenly lost power this morning, and it still isn't back, so we can't do anything.
B: Really? So now, can you still get your goods out in time?

text.traditional:
A：沒想到小顧計畫要去旅遊的國家，昨天發生了嚴重的大地震。
B：是啊。這下子他得改變計畫了。
text.simplified:
A：没想到小顾计划要去旅游的国家，昨天发生了严重的大地震。
B：是啊。这下子他得改变计划了。
text.pinyin:
A: Méixiǎngdào Xiǎo Gù jìhuà yào qù lǚyóu de guójiā, zuótiān fāshēng le yánzhòng de dà dìzhèn.
B: Shì a. Zhèxiàzi tā děi gǎibiàn jìhuà le.
text.english:
A: Who would have thought the country Xiao Gu was planning to visit would be hit by a severe earthquake yesterday?
B: Yes. So now he'll have to change his plans.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When talking about a certain event or situation in a conversation, the person speaking expresses his or her own views, or their immediate reaction to a sudden change in the situation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that the same person or thing is both A and B with 既……又……, when A and B are both good or both bad.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示同一個主語具有兩種狀態或情況。「既」跟「又」後面常接形容詞、動詞或動詞短語，形容詞前面不可以加副詞，動詞前面可加能願動詞「會、要、能、願意」等。所連接的兩個狀態或情況，必須同樣是正面的或負面的。而「又」後面狀態或情況的程度，比「既」來得更高一些。「既……又……」比「又……又……」書面。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 既 + Quality 1 + 又 + Quality 2

text.traditional: ……不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便……
text.simplified: ……不同地区的人也能在网路上一起开会，既省时间又方便……
text.pinyin: …Bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn…
text.english: ...people in different regions can also hold meetings together online, which both saves time and is convenient...

text.traditional: 陳教授既是我的好老師，又是我的老朋友，我很重視我們的友誼。
text.simplified: 陈教授既是我的好老师，又是我的老朋友，我很重视我们的友谊。
text.pinyin: Chén jiàoshòu jì shì wǒ de hǎo lǎoshī, yòu shì wǒ de lǎo péngyǒu, wǒ hěn zhòngshì wǒmen de yǒuyí.
text.english: Professor Chen is both my good teacher and my old friend, and I value our friendship very much.

text.traditional: 阮小姐對穿著很講究，她對衣服的要求是既要品質好，又要設計佳。
text.simplified: 阮小姐对穿着很讲究，她对衣服的要求是既要品质好，又要设计佳。
text.pinyin: Ruǎn xiǎojiě duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiù, tā duì yīfu de yāoqiú shì jì yào pǐnzhí hǎo, yòu yào shèjì jiā.
text.english: Miss Ruan is very particular about what she wears: she wants her clothes to be both of good quality and well designed.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 既……又…… indicates that the same subject has two states or situations. 既 and 又 are often followed by adjectives, verbs, or verb phrases. Adverbs are not used in front of adjectives, though volitive auxiliary verbs such as 會, 要, 能, 願意, etc. can be added before verbs. The adjectives, verbs or verb phrases following 既 and 又 must both be positive or negative. The level of the state or the situation after 又 is higher than 既. Finally, 既……又……is used more in written language than 又……又…….

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say 'not to mention' or 'let alone' with 更別說……了, adding a case so obvious it needs no more words.
grammarPages.explanation: 「更別說」的意思是「不必說」、「不需要說」，因為「更別說」後面所表達的情況是非常清楚的，不需要再多說。
grammarPages.pattern: Basic Case + 更別說 + Advanced Case + 了

text.traditional: ……既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
text.simplified: ……既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
text.pinyin: …Jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng biéshuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxī děng jīběn fúwù le.
text.english: …it's both time-saving and convenient, not to mention basic services such as downloading personal data and sending messages.

text.traditional: 我奶奶連怎麼上傳資料都不會，更別說建立自己的網站了。
text.simplified: 我奶奶连怎么上传资料都不会，更别说建立自己的网站了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai lián zěnme shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì, gèng biéshuō jiànlì zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn le.
text.english: My grandma can't even figure out how to upload data, let alone build her own website.

text.traditional: 溫先生一見到陌生人，就害羞得說不出話來，更別說要他演講了。
text.simplified: 温先生一见到陌生人，就害羞得说不出话来，更别说要他演讲了。
text.pinyin: Wēn xiānshēng yí jiàn dào mòshēngrén, jiù hàixiū de shuō bù chū huà lái, gèng biéshuō yào tā yǎnjiǎng le.
text.english: As soon as Mr. Wen sees a stranger, he gets so shy he can't say a word, let alone give a speech.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 更別說 means the same as 不必說 or 不需要說. Because the situation after 更別說 is very clear, there is no need to say more.

BOOK3_LESSON_THIRTEEN_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 4–5 · Towards The New Cloud Era

dialogue.title: 短文 · 走向雲端的新時代

text.traditional: 想當年還沒有雲端科技時，人們不論想閱讀某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某類題材的文章，都得到圖書館去查資料、借書。不過，自從有了雲端之後，人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
text.simplified: 想当年还没有云端科技时，人们不论想阅读某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某类题材的文章，都得到图书馆去查资料、借书。不过，自从有了云端之后，人们就是不出门，也可透过网路满足相关的需求。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dāngnián háiméi yǒu yúnduān kējì shí, rénmen búlùn xiǎng yuèdú mǒu wèi zuòzhě chūbǎn de zuòpǐn, huòshì xūyào zhǎo mǒu lèi tícái de wénzhāng, dōu děi dào túshūguǎn qù chá zīliào, jiè shū. Búguò, zìcóng yǒu le yúnduān zhīhòu, rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
text.english: Back in the days before cloud technology, whether people wanted to read works published by an author or find articles on a topic, they had to go to libraries to research and borrow books. Since the advent of the cloud, however, people can satisfy relevant needs online without leaving home.

text.traditional: 雲端科技的主要功能，是讓人們能隨時隨地上傳或下載資料；也因為不需要使用紙、筆來記錄，還能為地球的環保盡一份力量。以往，雲端科技多用來管理資料和電子郵件；現在遇到淹水、颱風的特殊情況，不出門也能在家開會或學習，把該做的事情都做好。上班族在家中裝上了攝影機，透過手機或電腦能看到家人的活動情況，要是他們碰上了麻煩，就能立刻請鄰居或警察協助。除了個人，企業在管理公共空間或服務方面也用得著雲端。比如說，旅館透過雲端掌握房客進出的情況、調整房間內冷氣的強弱等等。以上都是雲端科技帶來的好處。
text.simplified: 云端科技的主要功能，是让人们能随时随地上传或下载资料；也因为不需要使用纸、笔来记录，还能为地球的环保尽一份力量。以往，云端科技多用来管理资料和电子邮件；现在遇到淹水、台风的特殊情况，不出门也能在家开会或学习，把该做的事情都做好。上班族在家中装上了摄影机，透过手机或电脑能看到家人的活动情况，要是他们碰上了麻烦，就能立刻请邻居或警察协助。除了个人，企业在管理公共空间或服务方面也用得着云端。比如说，旅馆透过云端掌握房客进出的情况、调整房间内冷气的强弱等等。以上都是云端科技带来的好处。
text.pinyin: Yúnduān kējì de zhǔyào gōngnéng, shì ràng rénmen néng suíshí suídì shàngchuán huò xiàzài zīliào; yě yīnwèi bù xūyào shǐyòng zhǐ, bǐ lái jìlù, hái néng wèi dìqiú de huánbǎo jìn yí fèn lìliàng. Yǐwǎng, yúnduān kējì duō yòng lái guǎnlǐ zīliào hé diànzǐ yóujiàn; xiànzài yùdào yānshuǐ, táifēng de tèshū qíngkuàng, bù chūmén yě néng zài jiā kāihuì huò xuéxí, bǎ gāi zuò de shìqíng dōu zuò hǎo. Shàngbān zú zài jiā zhōng zhuāng shàng le shèyǐng jī, tòuguò shǒujī huò diànnǎo néng kàndào jiārén de huódòng qíngkuàng, yàoshì tāmen pèngshàng le máfán, jiù néng lìkè qǐng línjū huò jǐngchá xiézhù. Chúle gèrén, qìyè zài guǎnlǐ gōnggòng kōngjiān huò fúwù fāngmiàn yě yòngdezháo yúnduān. Bǐrú shuō, lǚguǎn tòuguò yúnduān zhǎngwò fángkè jìnchū de qíngkuàng, tiáozhěng fángjiān nèi lěngqì de qiángruò děngděng. Yǐshàng dōu shì yúnduān kējì dàilái de hǎochù.
text.english: The main function of cloud technology is to let people upload or download data anytime, anywhere; and because there is no need to use paper and pens to record things, it can also do its part to protect the earth's environment. In the past, cloud technology was mostly used to manage data and email; now, in special situations such as floods and typhoons, people can hold meetings or study at home without going out, and get done everything they need to do. Office workers who have installed cameras at home can see what their family members are doing through their phones or computers; if their family members run into trouble, they can immediately ask the neighbors or the police for help. Besides individuals, businesses also find the cloud useful in managing public spaces or services. For example, hotels use the cloud to keep track of guests coming and going, adjust the strength of the air conditioning in the rooms, and so on. All of the above are benefits that cloud technology brings.

text.traditional: 但話說回來，雖然雲端的優點不少，卻還是有現實的問題需要克服。例如某個時刻突然停電了，或是連不上網路，再重要的會議也只能暫時停下來；也可能因為雲端系統出現安全問題，上傳的資料突然沒了或被偷了。所以最好別太依靠雲端，重要資料也應多存一份。
text.simplified: 但话说回来，虽然云端的优点不少，却还是有现实的问题需要克服。例如某个时刻突然停电了，或是连不上网路，再重要的会议也只能暂时停下来；也可能因为云端系统出现安全问题，上传的资料突然没了或被偷了。所以最好别太依靠云端，重要资料也应多存一份。
text.pinyin: Dàn huàshuō huílái, suīrán yúnduān de yōudiǎn bùshǎo, què háishì yǒu xiànshí de wèntí xūyào kèfú. Lìrú mǒu ge shíkè túrán tíngdiàn le, huòshì lián bú shàng wǎnglù, zài zhòngyào de huìyì yě zhǐ néng zhànshí tíng xiàlái; yě kěnéng yīnwèi yúnduān xìtǒng chūxiàn ānquán wèntí, shàngchuán de zīliào túrán méi le huò bèi tōu le. Suǒyǐ zuìhǎo bié tài yīkào yúnduān, zhòngyào zīliào yě yīng duō cún yí fèn.
text.english: But then again, although the cloud has many advantages, there are still real problems that need to be overcome. For example, if the power suddenly goes out at some moment, or you can't connect to the internet, even the most important meeting has to stop for the time being; and security problems in the cloud system may also cause uploaded data to suddenly disappear or be stolen. So it's best not to rely too much on the cloud, and you should also save an extra copy of important data.

text.traditional: 雲端就像一張大網，把各種資源連在一起，提供各式各樣的服務，一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式，對全球商業、教育、文化等方面都產生了重大的影響，相信未來雲端能夠帶領我們走向美好的新時代。
text.simplified: 云端就像一张大网，把各种资源连在一起，提供各式各样的服务，一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式，对全球商业、教育、文化等方面都产生了重大的影响，相信未来云端能够带领我们走向美好的新时代。
text.pinyin: Yúnduān jiù xiàng yì zhāng dà wǎng, bǎ gèzhǒng zīyuán lián zài yìqǐ, tígōng gèshìgèyàng de fúwù, yìfāngmiàn dài gěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yìfāngmiàn yě dài gěi qìyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, duì quánqiú shāngyè, jiàoyù, wénhuà děng fāngmiàn dōu chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng, xiāngxìn wèilái yúnduān nénggòu dàilǐng wǒmen zǒuxiàng měihǎo de xīn shídài.
text.english: The cloud is like a big net that links all kinds of resources together and provides all kinds of services. On the one hand, it brings people a more convenient life; on the other hand, it also brings businesses better ways of managing. It has had a major impact on business, education, culture and other areas around the world, and I believe that in the future the cloud will be able to lead us into a wonderful new era.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that even if something happened, the result would stay the same, with 就是……也…… ('even if… still…').
grammarPages.explanation: 「就是」的後面是假設的情況，就算發生這些情況，「也」後面的結果也不會因為這樣而改變。

text.traditional: ……人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
text.simplified: ……人们就是不出门，也可透过网路满足相关的需求。
text.pinyin: …Rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
text.english: ...even if people do not go out, they can still meet related needs through the internet.

text.traditional: 為了追求夢想，就是吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
text.simplified: 为了追求梦想，就是吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。
text.pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, jiùshì chī zài duō kǔ, wǒ yě yào jiānchí dàodǐ.
text.english: To pursue my dream, I'll keep going to the end, even if I have to endure a great deal of hardship.

text.traditional: 林老闆既然做了決定就不會改變，就是總統來跟他說也沒用。
text.simplified: 林老板既然做了决定就不会改变，就是总统来跟他说也没用。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎobǎn jìrán zuò le juédìng jiù bú huì gǎibiàn, jiùshì zǒngtǒng lái gēn tā shuō yě méi yòng.
text.english: Since Boss Lin has made up his mind, he will not change it; even if the president came and told him, it would be useless.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就是 is followed by a hypothetical situation. Even if this situation should occur, the results after 也 will not change.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: On One Hand, On the Other Hand (一方面……一方面……)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Present two parallel aspects, reasons, or objectives of a situation using 一方面……，一方面…….
grammarPages.explanation: 使用「一方面……，一方面……」的句式說明一件事情兩個方面的原因、結果或目的等，前後兩句沒有重要程度的差別。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一方面 + Aspect 1, + 一方面 + Aspect 2

text.traditional: ……一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式……
text.simplified: ……一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式……
text.pinyin: …Yìfāngmiàn dàigěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yìfāngmiàn yě dàigěi qìyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì…
text.english: ...on the one hand it brings people a more convenient life, and on the other hand it also brings enterprises better management methods...

text.traditional: 錢老闆每天從早忙到晚，一方面要照顧生意，一方面要訓練員工，連陪家人的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 钱老板每天从早忙到晚，一方面要照顾生意，一方面要训练员工，连陪家人的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn měitiān cóng zǎo máng dào wǎn, yìfāngmiàn yào zhàogù shēngyì, yìfāngmiàn yào xùnliàn yuángōng, lián péi jiārén de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: Boss Qian is busy from morning till night: on the one hand he has to look after the business, and on the other hand he has to train his staff. He doesn't even have time to spend with his family.

text.traditional: 店員建議我買這部筆電，一方面打了折之後便宜得多，一方面筆電該有的功能它都有。
text.simplified: 店员建议我买这部笔电，一方面打了折之后便宜得多，一方面笔电该有的功能它都有。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán jiànyì wǒ mǎi zhè bù bǐ diàn, yìfāngmiàn dǎ le zhé zhīhòu piányí de duō, yìfāngmiàn bǐ diàn gāi yǒu de gōngnéng tā dōu yǒu.
text.english: The shop clerk suggested I buy this laptop: on the one hand it is much cheaper after the discount, and on the other hand it has all the functions a laptop should have.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The use of the phrase 一方面……，一方面……can explain the cause, result or purpose of two aspects of a thing, and there is no important difference between the preceding and following sentences.
